The tlj deduction comes through a new commission read port readTljDeductFen instead of a cross-module table read. Contract: the operation's x-implementation marker is removed (repository convention for implemented, decision 45) and route schemas regenerated. withdrawn_fen is 0 until B2-05 (TODO).
